title: Bi-Oriented Interlaced Matrix Multiplication and an Operator Factorisation of the Quantum Harmonic Oscillator
summary: We introduce a bi-oriented interlaced matrix product on $2\times 2$ matrices over a unital, possibly non-associative algebra, extending a matrix mnemonic for Cayley--Dickson doubling. The opposite orientations $X_R$ and $X_L$ coincide precisely when the underlying algebra is commutative. For the canonical position and momentum operators $Q,P$ on $L^2(\mathbb{R})$, a matrix $D$ and its companion $\widetilde{D}$ satisfy, on the common Schwartz domain, $\widetilde{D} X_R D =\widetilde{D} X_L D =2H Id_2$, where $H=(P^2+Q^2)/2$.
